```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
# them but doesn't run them again.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(engine = function(options) {
  if (options$engine == "bash") options$eval <- FALSE
  options
})
```

```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/minpath

head ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv

head ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv | awk -F '\t' '{print $1,$5}'

head ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{print $1,$5}'

head ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'

cat ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'

cat ../prokka/metabat.3/metabat.3.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus' > metabat.3.ec

minpath -ec metabat.3.ec -report metabat.3.ec.report -details metabat.3.ec.details

head metabat.3.ec.report 

while read bin;do 
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)}' | grep -v '^locus' > ${bin}.ec 
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do 
  minpath -ec ${bin}.ec -report ${bin}.ec.report -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report

grep 'metabat.22/metabat.3/contig_112' ../gtdbtk/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv

grep 'PWY-5360' *.ec.report
```

select minipath directory

look for a single bin in the .tsv file

only want uniqueID (column 1) and EC number (column 5) for each gene, so alter format using awk

filter further to only include lines with an EC number

separate output tab and remove header line

change head to cat to include all genes

then send output to a file so it can be used as an input for minipath

run minipath and look at first few lines

prepare minipath inputs for all bins, then run to all bins

search for "PWY-101" across all bins and answer questions, comparing against gtdbtk

search for "PWY-5360" across all bins and answer questions

~~~

Questions 4.1:
How many bins contain at least one gene from this pathway?

3

Which bin has all of the genes (ie a complete pathway)?

contig_112

For which bins does minpath keep the pathway (minpath 1)?

metabat.22 and metabat.3

Questions 4.2:
How many bins contain the pathway PWY-5360?

1

What order (in a taxonomic sense) do these bins belong to? Are they in the same family?
order Entobacterales, not particularly in the same family

How strong is the evidence that these bins really have this pathway? Look at the fam-found and minpath columns.
not very strong, fam-found is 1 and minpath is 0
~~~

Metabolic pathways inferred from the Prokka annotations with MinPath. Commands for this step were run in `minpath/`.
